en: A black‑and‑white interior view of a richly decorated chapel or small church, looking down the central aisle toward the altar. Wooden pews line both sides, and the apse and ceiling are covered with Christian frescoes and icons, including a central image of the Virgin Mary with angels. There are arched windows along the walls and hanging lamps. In the bottom right corner the caption 'La Cappella' is printed.
